qf.appRumorHtml: Rumor has it there is an SS VIBELANDIA QUESTFEST App in the works! For those in the know. Now you know.

qf.tagline: Thirteen channels. One story. You can land in the lyrics: shout-out, whole track, or a nine-song run for your city.
qf.heroAmericasHtml: Wrong Side of Town and the Reno holographic swamp are music from the wrong side of town in the Americas - from the North Slope of Alaska to Tierra del Fuego - celebrating, metabolizing, and crystallizing their beats, vibes, languages, and perreo.

qf.ledePocketHtml: We are not here to drown you in pages. Listen first. If the frequency hits, step to the casting call below or tip on the rails - Fair Exchange, you and the Captain, no suit in the middle.
qf.ledeCastingHtml: Wrong Side of Town: The Musical is booking cast, not crowd filler. Subject line on every email: ACTIVATE THE WRONG SIDE OF TOWN: THE MUSICAL - in the body, say which lane you are reading for (shout-out, lead track, or nine-song city run).
qf.offer100Body: A named beat in the mix, voiced on the record - you are credited in the Wrong Side story, not wallpaper.
qf.offer1kBody: Your song, you center frame - written and produced here, golden-ratio mix discipline, built to open on the feed.
qf.offer10kBody: A full run for your town or your movement - cast the place in nine tracks, Sovereign Node energy.
qf.ledePassesHtml: Festival passes (GA, day, Bachstage, Golden) run on the same Fair Exchange rails. Email ACTIVATE / QUESTFEST or use the apps below.
qf.h2StudioHtml: The holographic AI behind Wrong Side of Town: The Musical is not just theory
qf.ledeStudio1Html: The show runs on phones and speakers you already own - but underneath it is a real awareness OS metaphor: honest boundaries, phi-locked structure, and thirteen channels that stay in sync with something you can inspect, not a black-box feed that vanishes when the tour leaves town.
qf.ledeStudio2Html: Digital Pru ASIC is the name we give that layer when it stops being a slide deck and becomes operating code - a deterministic API, a phi engine, QIHOH metadata in the payload, and an RTL core you can simulate. It is the silicon-shaped mirror of the Hit Factory: same ratios, same honesty contract, runnable on the Digital Pru reader (full spec) and in the Hood - mirrored canon docs below; standalone deploy may be private on GitHub.
qf.ledeStudio3Html: That changes the game for cast and listeners: big stages sell trust us. This stack says show the pipe - read the thirteen papers in the Hood, clone the repo, run the tests. Fair Exchange stops being a slogan and becomes verifiable rhythm between story, silicon, and the street.
qf.footerNavHtml: 13 papers - Digital Pru - Machote and Reno swamp (plain) - SING 9 - Big shows vs. Wrong Side

meta.title: The Hood - 13 papers - plain English
meta.desc: Thirteen docs in plain order: Digital Pru, QIHOH, ASIC, then context. All open on this site where possible.
meta.ogDesc: Plain walkthrough of the reading list: start at 01-03, then add context. Same voice as the Digital Pru plain tour.

hood.heroHtml: The Hood is the reading list for Digital Pru and the Hit Factory stack. Each link opens on this site when we host the file (outside papers are labeled). You do not need to hunt a private repo. If you only read three, read 01 through 03: the whitepaper tour, the full QIHOH markdown, and the ASIC coherence note - that is where the story meets what you can check.
hood.plainIntro: Same idea as the plain-talk section on the whitepaper: short blocks, top to bottom, no mystery. The first three are the spine. The rest adds background without replacing them.
hood.pass1p: Open the Digital Pru reader (especially the plain tour), then the QIHOH theory file, then the ASIC coherence paper. That line is the contract: what we say in public, what shows up in JSON, and what you can run or audit.
hood.pass2h: Next two: house rules and big story (04-05)
hood.pass2p: The MCA catalog is the vocabulary and guardrails. The Shift prospectus is the flagship why for the wider movement. Both keep language from floating away from what the stack actually does.
hood.pass3p: Gateway paper, hydrogen-sun-jupiter metaphor, RF note, silica prospectus - helpful lanes if you are tracing hardware or materials language. They support the spine; they do not replace 01-03.
hood.pass4p: Houdini methodology, Hero Jo bio, HHF paradigm essay, and the short recursion note - these keep marketing, story, and instrument claims in separate boxes while the art stays loud.
hood.papersSub: Plain blurbs below; titles match the files. Click through to read.
